title: Customer Authorisation Card — Taking Metered Points onto an Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscription
content:
# Taking Metered Points onto a Subscription

Authorisation card for the amendment of coverage on a subscription under Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions.

## What the amendment does

When a building owner authorises the metered points their site actually meters to be taken onto an energy monitoring subscription, the subscription's annual fee is restated for the points and dashboard users it then covers. The covered point count and the annual fee standing on the subscription both change, and the change is stamped on the subscription as a points addition dated the day it is made, so the owner sees the new coverage and the new fee on the account at once.

## How the authorisation is given

`authorise_meter_coverage_01d41e30` is the building owner's own tool, because the amendment commits them to a higher annual fee: the client services agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it, on their own authority.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `subscription_id` | the reference number of the energy monitoring subscription whose coverage is being authorised, as the client services agent states it when handing the authorisation over | Id |
| `meters_covered` | the number of metered points the subscription is to cover after the authorisation, expressed exactly as the record holds it | integer, meters; never blank and never carrying a fractional part |
| `annual_fee_usd` | the annual fee the subscription is to carry after the authorisation | USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent as it is entered |

## Return

A confirmation sentence in plain text naming the subscription, the number of metered points it now covers and the annual fee in USD to two decimal places now standing on it. Any sentence of that shape means the coverage and the fee on the account have both been changed. No other return is defined.
